key_points: Illumination Acquisition Corp I filed Form 8-K on April 13, 2026 disclosing appointment of John DeMarais as Chief Operating Officer.

He has supported the sponsor of six SPAC business combinations and been involved in over 20 SPAC transactions across the full lifecycle.
The company is incorporated in the Cayman Islands, listed on Nasdaq under ticker symbols ILLUU (units), ILLU (shares), and ILLUW (warrants).
